name: Iconik Sports and Events Limited
about: Iconik Sports and Events Limited operates as a sports and events management company in India. It also engages in the sports infrastructure development, league management, commercial sports ventures, and digital innovation. The company was formerly known as ID Info Business Services Limited and changed its name to Iconik Sports and Events Limited in April 2025. Iconik Sports and Events Limited was incorporated in 1940 and is based in Mumbai, India.
